request.amount_ada: 500,000,000 ada net cap on total Treasury Withdrawals during the period; no withdrawal amount requested
request.deadline: period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit
Apply a cumulative lovelace accounting method that excludes Treasury inflows
request.what: Agree a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713 through an Info action with no direct on-chain effect and no authorization of any Treasury Withdrawal.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for the Cardano Treasury during Epochs 613-713.
The Net Change Limit caps only the cumulative lovelace removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the Epoch 613-713 period count toward the 500,000,000 ada limit and remain valid.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has served as a useful fiscal guardrail but is becoming practically constrained before mid-2027.
The proposer claims the 500,000,000 ada limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed guardrail and simple accounting.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake record DRep agreement to the Net Change Limit under threshold TREASURY-01a.
The proposal states it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references an IPFS copy of that Constitution.
The proposer claims nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document asks DReps to signal agreement to a higher 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, replacing a prior 350,000,000 ada limit for the same period, while stating that the action does not itself authorize spending.
